caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a horse-drawn cutter sleigh. The main object is a wooden sleigh with curved runners and an ornate, cream-colored body that has multiple panels and a slightly convex front and back. The seat is upholstered in a tufted, mauve or pale purple fabric, and the wooden structure shows detailed construction with cross-beams and supports beneath the seat. Above the sleigh, there are two intricate shield-like crests—one on the left in red, gold, and blue labeled "image design on back," and one on the right in blue, gold, and red, labeled "center design on dash." Below the sleigh, there is a close-up side view of the seat, showing the red and black coloration with gold decorative filigree. There is also a gold corner design element in the lower right and the text “GOOSE-NECK CUTTER / KLINE-MUSEY, N.Y. / ROLLAND W. AYRES” written at the bottom right corner, along with smaller labels describing each element. The composition is on a plain, off-white background.
title: Goose Neck Cutter
